description: Zones de collecte des systèmes d'assainissement de Rennes Métropole is a dataset listed in Rennes-metropole open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Rennes Métropole. Cette couche représente la zone de collecte du réseau de canalisations et ouvrages associés qui recueille et achemine les eaux usées depuis la partie publique des branchements particuliers, ceux-ci compris, jusqu'au point de rejet dans la station de traitement des eaux usées. Coverage: Rennes Métropole. The portal files it under Réseaux, Energie. Its keywords are assainissement urbain, réseau d'égouts, rejet d'eaux usées, santé publique et assainissement. The portal shows 28 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2021-10-22 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence ODbL 1.0 (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-rennesmetropole-fr-portal.
